name: Chongqing Municipal People's Government (Chongqing SASAC)
via: city-level government of Chongqing, China; its State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Chongqing SASAC) is a body directly under the municipal government and exercises the state's ownership rights in the city's state-owned enterprises
note: Southwest Securities' January 2025 acquisition report describes the Chongqing Municipal SASAC as a special institution directly under the Chongqing Municipal People's Government, performing the government's investor duties for state-owned assets.
